items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I know his family's good. They used to live right at the corner from us, sonny. Yeah. Right at Orleans and Roman. Yeah. Mitchell.

ctx.x: Yeah, John Porter. John Porter, yeah. Who was this guy, Basie, by the way? Huh? Basie. Oh, Lil Basie. Lil Basie was good, too. The little kid went, you know, little bit of kid went to California by that day?
Oh, yeah, yeah. Oh, yeah. He was good on it, too. Yeah, yeah. He was pretty good on it, too. That's right. Yeah, Lil Basie. Yeah. He went to California.
